description: Preview a Solinkify Gate paywall (HTTP 402 / x402) without paying: price, currency, and available access modes (pay-per-request, prepaid, subscription). Call this before gate_fetch to learn the price. Costs nothing and never moves money.

url.description: Absolute https:// URL of the gated page or API endpoint to inspect, e.g. https://example.com/api/report. If the URL is not paywalled the tool says so instead of returning a price.

name: gate_get_price
